title: FlashTTS: Fast Streaming TTS with MTP Acceleration and X-pred Mean Flow Distillation
title_zh: FlashTTS：结合 MTP 加速与 X-pred Mean Flow 蒸馏的快速流式 TTS
abstract_en: Recent progress in speech dialogue systems requires Text-to-Speech (TTS) models to be faster and more responsive. Modern speech dialogue systems impose two primary requirements on TTS models: low latency and support for streaming inputs and outputs. However, most existing single-codebook LLM-based TTS methods rely on multi-stage pipelines that lack native streaming capabilities. These systems typically suffer from high end-to-end latency due to slow autoregressive prediction and multi-step flow matching. To address these limitations, we propose FlashTTS, an open-source and low-latency streaming TTS framework. FlashTTS introduces a lagged multi-track architecture that natively processes streaming text and speech inputs, thereby eliminating the need for sentence-level buffering. To accelerate acoustic generation, we integrate parallel Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) with an X-pred mean flow matching decoder. This configuration achieves high-fidelity token-to-mel generation in exactly two function evaluations (2-NFE). By jointly optimizing input processing and decoding efficiency, FlashTTS offers a practical foundation for real-time speech dialogue systems. Experiments show that FlashTTS substantially reduces First-Packet Latency to 325ms compared to robust streaming baselines, all while preserving strong zero-shot voice cloning and cross-lingual intelligibility. Speech samples are available. The model code and checkpoints will be released as open source.
abstract_zh: FlashTTS 是一个开源、低延迟的流式 Text-to-Speech（TTS）框架，面向实时语音对话系统对低延迟与输入/输出流式处理的需求。针对现有 single-codebook LLM-based TTS 方法依赖多阶段流水线、缺乏原生流式能力、端到端延迟高等问题，FlashTTS 提出 lagged multi-track architecture，可直接处理流式文本与语音输入，避免句级缓存。为加速声学生成，系统结合并行 Multi-Token Prediction（MTP）与 X-pred mean flow matching decoder，使 token-to-mel 生成仅需 2 次函数评估（2-NFE）即可完成。实验表明，FlashTTS 将 First-Packet Latency 降至 325ms，同时保持较强的 zero-shot voice cloning 能力与跨语言可懂度。
key_points_zh: 提出 FlashTTS，一个开源低延迟流式 TTS 框架，面向实时 speech dialogue systems。
采用 lagged multi-track architecture，原生支持流式文本和语音输入，避免传统句级 buffering 带来的等待延迟。
结合并行 Multi-Token Prediction（MTP）与 X-pred mean flow matching decoder，加速 autoregressive 与 token-to-mel 生成过程。
声学解码仅需 2-NFE，实现高保真 token-to-mel 生成，显著降低端到端推理开销。
实验中 First-Packet Latency 降至 325ms，并保持 zero-shot voice cloning 与 cross-lingual intelligibility 表现。

llm_assessment.comment: Highly relevant to realtime speech agents through low-latency streaming TTS architecture, though it does not directly address tool calling or multimodal grounding.
